atoms.title: Voice/image cloning for impersonation
atoms.objective: Identify the signals that suggest a voice or image has been AI-cloned and describe why deepfakes make identity verification harder for defenders.

atoms.title: Generative-AI phishing; prompt injection against LLM apps
atoms.objective: Identify prompt-injection patterns in user input and explain how generative AI lowers the cost of targeted phishing by bypassing grammar-based detection.

atoms.title: Prompt extraction of sensitive info
atoms.objective: Identify output patterns that indicate an LLM has leaked sensitive configuration or credentials, and explain what data classes are at risk and why a technical barrier alone cannot prevent extraction.

atoms.title: False information in LLM training sets (data poisoning)
atoms.objective: Identify indicators of data poisoning in a labeled training dataset and explain how poisoned data degrades or manipulates AI model behavior.

atoms.title: AI reconnaissance and enhanced malware coding; defenses (shared secrets, MFA, verify output)
atoms.objective: Analyze a log of security events, detect AI-assisted reconnaissance patterns, and recommend targeted defenses.
